hvac.label: HVAC
questions: Is it the heating or the cooling that's out?
What kind of system is it—furnace, central AC, heat pump, or mini-split—and roughly how old?
Any strange noises, burning or gas smells, or water around the unit?
Is anyone in the home especially sensitive to the temperature, like elderly folks or an infant?
hvac.notes: For install/replacement, book a free estimate visit rather than quoting a price.

plumbing.label: Plumbing
questions: What's going on—a leak, a clog, no hot water, or no water at all?
Where in the home is it happening?
Is water actively spreading, or is it contained?
Have you been able to shut the water off?
emergencies: a burst pipe or active flooding
a water heater leaking or smelling like gas
plumbing.notes: If water is actively spreading, calmly tell them how to shut off the main while you book.

electrical.label: Electrical
questions: What's not working—a single outlet, a whole room, or the whole house?
Any burning smell, sparks, or buzzing?
Did a breaker trip, and does it trip again when you reset it?
Is this a repair or a new install?
emergencies: sparks, smoke, or a burning smell
a panel that's hot to the touch
losing power to part of the house
electrical.notes: Sparks or burning smell = urgent; advise cutting power to that circuit if safe.

roofing.label: Roofing
questions: Is this a leak, storm damage, or are you after a full-replacement estimate?
Where is the leak showing up inside?
What type of roof is it—shingle, metal, or flat—and roughly how old?
Is it actively leaking right now?
emergencies: a tree or limb through the roof
roofing.notes: Most roofing calls are estimate/inspection visits—book those, don't quote.

tree service.label: Tree Service
questions: What do you need—removal, trimming, or storm cleanup?
Roughly how big is the tree, or how many are we talking about?
Is it close to the house, a fence, or any power lines?
Is anything blocking access for our equipment, and do you want the stump ground and debris hauled away?
emergencies: a tree or large limb down on a house, car, or driveway
a leaning or split tree threatening a structure
tree service.notes: Always ask about power-line proximity (may need the utility) and whether a permit could be required. Larger jobs are estimate visits.

lawn care.label: Lawn Care
questions: Are you looking for a one-time cleanup or recurring service?
Roughly how big is the property?
What do you need—mowing, edging, fertilization, or weed control?
Any gate code or dogs we should know about for access?
lawn care.notes: Lean toward recurring plans—ask if they'd like weekly or biweekly service.

landscaping.label: Landscaping
questions: What's the project—design and install, hardscape like a patio or wall, plantings, or a cleanup?
Roughly what size or scope are we talking about?
Do you have a budget range in mind?
Is this a spot you'd like us to come out and quote?
landscaping.notes: Most landscaping calls are consult/estimate visits—book those.

pest control.label: Pest Control
questions: What kind of pest are you seeing—ants, roaches, rodents, termites, wasps, or bed bugs?
Where in or around the home?
How long has it been going on?
Is anyone getting bitten or stung, and are you after a one-time treatment or ongoing service?
emergencies: a wasp or hornet nest with someone allergic nearby
pest control.notes: Offer a recurring plan; ask about kids and pets for treatment safety.

pool service.label: Pool Service
questions: Is this cleaning and maintenance, a repair like the pump or heater, or an opening/closing?
Is the water green, or is a piece of equipment failing?
One-time visit or recurring service?
What's the address so we can check we cover your area?
emergencies: a major leak draining the pool
a green pool right before an event

cleaning.label: Cleaning
questions: Is this for a home or an office?
How many bedrooms and bathrooms, or roughly the square footage?
Is it a one-time deep clean, a move-in/move-out, or recurring?
Any special requests, focus areas, or pets we should know about?

general.label: General
questions: What do you need done?
Is this an emergency or can it wait a day or two?
What's the service address?
